title: Base change maps of modules are compatible with restriction to open subschemes
statement:
For a commutative square of morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] $f\circ v=u\circ f_1$, with $f:X\to S$, $u:T\to S$, $f_1:X_1\to T$, $v:X_1\to X$, and an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], the *base change map* $\beta_{\mathcal F}:u^*f_*\mathcal F\to f_{1*}v^*\mathcal F$ of the square is the morphism of $\mathcal O_T$-modules corresponding, under the adjunction $u^*\dashv u_*$ of pullback and pushforward of modules [def-pc-module-pullback], to $f_*(\eta_{v,\mathcal F}):f_*\mathcal F\to f_*v_*v^*\mathcal F=u_*f_{1*}v^*\mathcal F$, where $\eta_v$ is the unit of $v^*\dashv v_*$ and the equality holds because both sheaves have the sections $(v^*\mathcal F)(v^{-1}f^{-1}W)=(v^*\mathcal F)(f_1^{-1}u^{-1}W)$ over an open $W\subseteq S$; $\beta$ is natural in $\mathcal F$. Let $f:X\to S$, $f':X'\to S'$, $g:S'\to S$, $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes with $f\circ g'=g\circ f'$, and let $j_U:U\to S$, $j_V:V\to S'$, $j_X:X_U\to X$, $j_{X'}:X'_V\to X'$ be open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion] (for instance inclusions of open subschemes, or isomorphisms) together with morphisms $f_U:X_U\to U$, $f'_V:X'_V\to V$, $g_V:V\to U$, $g'_V:X'_V\to X_U$ such that $f\circ j_X=j_U\circ f_U$, $f'\circ j_{X'}=j_V\circ f'_V$, $g\circ j_V=j_U\circ g_V$, $g'\circ j_{X'}=j_X\circ g'_V$, $f_U\circ g'_V=g_V\circ f'_V$, $j_X(X_U)=f^{-1}(j_U(U))$ and $j_{X'}(X'_V)=f'^{-1}(j_V(V))$. Let $\beta$ be the base change map of the square $(f,f',g,g')$ and $\beta^{\circ}$ that of $(f_U,f'_V,g_V,g'_V)$. Then: (1) the base change maps $\rho_{\mathcal F}:j_U^*f_*\mathcal F\to f_{U*}j_X^*\mathcal F$ of the square $(f,f_U,j_U,j_X)$ and $\rho'_{\mathcal G}:j_V^*f'_*\mathcal G\to f'_{V*}j_{X'}^*\mathcal G$ of $(f',f'_V,j_V,j_{X'})$ are isomorphisms for all $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F$ and $\mathcal O_{X'}$-modules $\mathcal G$; (2) with the composition isomorphisms $c$ of pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback], the isomorphisms
$$a:j_V^*g^*f_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{c}(g j_V)^*f_*\mathcal F=(j_Ug_V)^*f_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{c^{-1}}g_V^*j_U^*f_*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{g_V^*\rho_{\mathcal F}}g_V^*f_{U*}j_X^*\mathcal F,$$
$$b:j_V^*f'_*g'^*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\rho'_{g'^*\mathcal F}}f'_{V*}j_{X'}^*g'^*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{c}f'_{V*}(g'j_{X'})^*\mathcal F=f'_{V*}(j_Xg'_V)^*\mathcal F\xrightarrow{c^{-1}}f'_{V*}g_V'^{*}j_X^*\mathcal F$$
satisfy $b\circ j_V^*(\beta_{\mathcal F})=\beta^{\circ}_{j_X^*\mathcal F}\circ a$ for every $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$. In particular $j_V^*(\beta_{\mathcal F})$ is an isomorphism if and only if $\beta^{\circ}_{j_X^*\mathcal F}$ is.
